g.text: Comprehensive Architectural Lineage for Optovue Solix Peripapillary RNFL Volumetric OCT Segmentation
KEY ARCHITECTURAL FINDINGS & MODEL TAXONOMY LESSONS

text.tspan: Bi-Planar Orthogonal Consensus Fusion jumped Dice
to 0.9518 and slashed median MABE from 12.6 to 4.7 µm.

g.text: Dense 3D U-Net is an Anisotropic Outlier Shield

text.tspan: Dense 3D U-Net operates across 3D voxels, eliminating
single-slice drift. While Bi-Planar has the lower median
error (4.71 vs 5.50 µm), Dense 3D achieves lower mean
MABE (5.87 µm) and lowest worst-case scan error (17.02 µm).

g.text: What Was Missed: Canonical STN Model

text.tspan: Patient head tilt introduces severe diagonal artifacts.
a Spatial Transformer predicting tilt θ ∈ [-25°, +25°],
bounding boundary drift below <0.8 µm under stress tilt.
